title: CoVA: Composing VAE Representations for Generative Learning
title_zh: CoVA：通过组合 VAE 表示实现生成式学习

paragraphs.en: CoVA 是一个轻量级框架，通过在线组合 VAE 特征，为流匹配训练提供分阶段的引导，从而提升生成式学习的效果。 Representation alignment with pretrained visual encoders improves diffusion transformer training but requires auxiliary encoders and extra training overhead. Recent approaches instead exploit representations from the generative model's own variational autoencoder (VAE). However, reconstruction-oriented VAE features are not optimized for the semantic discrimination and spatial structure needed for generative learning. We introduce \textbf{CoVA} (\textbf{Co}mposed \textbf{VA}E Representations), a lightweight framework that composes VAE features online into stage-wise guidance for flow-matching training. A small latent composer is jointly trained with class supervision, masked latent reconstruction, and horizontal-flip consistency, yielding semantically discriminative, spatially structured dense features and sample-dependent class posteriors. CoVA aligns intermediate SiT features with the composed representations early in training, then removes the increasingly detrimental alignment and reuses detached composer posteriors for sample-dependent soft label conditioning. We further uncover a hidden confound in soft label conditioning: averaging class embeddings attenuates their magnitude, coupling semantic interpolation with conditioning strength. This attenuation alone can substantially improve FID while degrading Recall, revealing a non-semantic source of the apparent gain. CoVA corrects this confound by restoring the hard-label magnitude, isolating posterior-dependent directional semantics. CoVA adds only 8.5M training-only auxiliary parameters (1.3\% of SiT-XL/2) and introduces no inference-time overhead. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, CoVA reduces SiT-XL/2 FID from 17.2 to 7.4 (\textbf{57\%}) in 400K steps. With classifier-free guidance, it achieves an FID of \textbf{2.03} in only 400 epochs, versus 2.06 after 1,400 epochs for vanilla SiT-XL/2.
paragraphs.zh: CoVA 是一个轻量级框架，通过在线组合 VAE 特征，为流匹配训练提供分阶段的引导，从而提升生成式学习的效果。与预训练视觉编码器进行表示对齐能够改进扩散变换器训练，但需要辅助编码器和额外的训练开销。 近期的方法转而利用生成模型自身变分自编码器（VAE）的表示。 然而，以重建为导向的 VAE 特征并未针对生成式学习所需的语义区分能力和空间结构进行优化。 我们提出了 \textbf{CoVA}（\textbf{Co}mposed \textbf{VA}E Representations），一个轻量级框架，它在线组合 VAE 特征，为流匹配训练提供分阶段的引导。 一个小型潜在变量组合器在类别监督、掩码潜在重建和水平翻转一致性约束下联合训练，从而生成具有语义区分能力和空间结构的密集特征以及样本相关的类别后验概率。 CoVA 在训练早期将中间 SiT 特征与组合后的表示对齐，随后移除逐渐产生负面影响的对齐机制，并重新利用解耦的组合器后验概率进行样本相关的软标签条件约束。 我们进一步揭示了软标签条件约束中一个隐藏的混淆因素：对类别嵌入取平均会削弱其幅度，从而将语义插值与条件强度耦合在一起。 仅这种幅度的削弱就能显著提升 FID，同时降低 Recall，表明表面上的性能提升存在非语义性的来源。 CoVA 通过恢复硬标签的幅度来纠正这一混淆因素，从而分离出依赖后验概率的方向性语义信息。 CoVA 仅增加 850 万个仅用于训练的辅助参数（占 SiT-XL/2 的 1.3\%），且不会引入推理时的额外开销。 在 ImageNet 256$\times$256 数据集上，CoVA 在 40 万步内将 SiT-XL/2 的 FID 从 17.2 降低至 7.4（\textbf{57\%}）。 在使用无分类器引导时，它仅需 400 个周期即可达到 \textbf{2.03} 的 FID，而传统 SiT-XL/2 则需要 1,400 个周期才能达到 2.06。
